messages.title: a - a +0 robe (worn).
messages.body:
<lightgrey>

A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or spellcasting. 

Base armour rating: 2       Encumbrance rating: 0

It can be maximally enchanted to +2.

If you take off this armour:
Your AC would decrease by 2.0 (2.0 -> 0.0).
Your EV would remain unchanged.


Stash search prefixes: {inventory} {body armour} {body armor}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified equipped armour
_________________

<darkgrey>“CLEOPATRA: Give me my robe, put on my crown; I have
 Immortal longings in me”
    -William Shakespeare, _Anthony & Cleopatra_, V, ii. ca. 1605.
